about_the_game:
This winter seems colder than usual，
the Circus that came suddenly,
bring in some touch of life to the small town.

The poor orphan girl,
the mysterious gentleman,
these incredible circus members,
all coming together.

The show is about to begin,
will these make the life more interesting?

☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆

This is a RPGmaker 2D exploration adventure game set in a small town.
Discovering items and encounters in this cold winter,
here as the start of a beginning.

☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆☆

Game Features:
・　25days adventure in a winter town with plenty puzzles to solve
・　Incredible character designs and lots of original artworks in game
・　5 areas with 20+ maps to research created in pixel style
・　Rich in stories with multiple endings to unlock based on player's actions and choice
